stem:
The dot plot shows the lengths of the 12 trailers sold at a store last month.

Which statement about the data is true?

options.label: F
options.text: The interquartile range is 7, and the range is 17.

options.label: G
options.text: The interquartile range is 7, and the range is 11.

options.label: H
options.text: The interquartile range is 2.75, and the range is 17.

options.label: J
options.text: The interquartile range is 2.75, and the range is 11.

visual_elements: dot plot showing trailer lengths with data points at 6 (4 dots), 9 (2 dots), 13 (4 dots), 17 (2 dots)
